sentences.text: Adrian Molina -LRB- born August 23 , 1985 -RRB- is an American screenwriter and storyboard artist .	screenwriter	screenwriter	storyboard artist	storyboard artist
He has been at Pixar since 2007 , where he started as a 2D animator on Ratatouille .	Pixar	Pixar	Ratatouille	Ratatouille (film)
He later moved on to be a storyboard artist , working on Toy Story 3 and Monsters University .	Toy Story 3	Toy Story 3	storyboard artist	storyboard artist	Monsters University	Monsters University

After writing for The Good Dinosaur , Molina started his first gig as a screenplay writer for Coco and later went on to co-direct the film .	Coco	Coco (2017 animated film)	The Good Dinosaur	The Good Dinosaur
Molina also illustrated the Little Golden Book for Toy Story 3 .	Toy Story 3	Toy Story 3	Little Golden Book	Little Golden Books
A native of Yuba City , California , he graduated from the California Institute of the Arts in 2007 .	California Institute of the Arts	California Institute of the Arts
Molina is married to Ryan Dooley .
